texts.preamble: Mrs. S. Deb (Gupta) vs Mr. Debalay Bhattacharjee on 3 January, 2022 Author: Indrajit Mahanty Bench: Indrajit Mahanty, S.G. Chattopadhyay Page 1 of 3 High Court Of Tripura Agartala Wp(C)(Pil) No.04/2021 For Petitioner(s) : Mrs. S. Deb (Gupta), Advocate, Mr. Bikram Paul, Advocate.
texts.facts: While hearing the matter, we find from the affidavit of the respondent no.3 that there appears to be a body known as "All Tripura Packaged Drinking Water Manufacturer Association" and such association had submitted a letter to the Chief Secretary of the Government of Tripura. We find from the cause title that although allegations have been made that packaged drinking water is being sold in the State of Tripura not meeting the standards set in the Food Safety and Standards Act, 2006, no producer or manufacturer or seller has been impleaded as respondent. Consequently, we are of the considered view that it is necessary to implead the All Tripura Packaged Drinking Water Manufacturer Association through its Secretary, office located at Tirupati Beverage, N.S. Road, Agartala, Tripura (West) as respondent no.5 and the Public Works Department (Drinking Water & Sanitation), Government of Tripura as respondent no.6. Notices need be issued to the newly added respondents, returnable within four weeks. He is directed to file affidavit indicating as to whether any testing laboratory or controlled mechanism exists for checking and testing water being manufactured and sold as packaged drinking water in the State of Tripura. We also direct impleadment of Food Safety and Standards Authority of India (FSSAI), FDA Bhawan, Kotla Road, New Delhi-110002 as respondent no.7.
